subsystems.name: Strain bank and selection
subsystems.role: source and characterise microbes with traits that help plants take up nutrients.
parts: screening assays for nutrient solubilisation or fixation

subsystems.name: Bioreactor cultivation
subsystems.role: grow the chosen microbes in controlled, sterile conditions.
parts: sensors for pH, oxygen and temperature

subsystems.name: Consortia design
subsystems.role: combine species that cooperate with each other and with the crop.

subsystems.name: Formulation and stabilisation
subsystems.role: keep the microbes alive and effective through storage and application.
parts: carriers such as peat, vermiculite or alginate beads

subsystems.name: Delivery and root colonisation
subsystems.role: introduce the microbes to the plant root zone in a vertical farm.

subsystems.name: Monitoring and control
subsystems.role: track whether the microbes survive and benefit the plants.

buildSteps.title: Define the target function
buildSteps.detail: Decide which job the microbiome must do, such as freeing phosphorus from insoluble minerals or fixing nitrogen.

buildSteps.title: Isolate and screen candidates
buildSteps.detail: Collect bacteria and fungi from soils, plant roots or culture collections and test them for the desired trait.

buildSteps.title: Characterise and engineer strains
buildSteps.detail: Sequence promising microbes and, where needed, modify them to boost nutrient uptake or survival.

buildSteps.title: Test combinations
buildSteps.detail: Mix species in the lab and in small plant trials to find consortia that do not outcompete each other and that help the crop.

buildSteps.title: Scale up cultivation
buildSteps.detail: Grow the selected strains in bioreactors, optimising media, oxygen and temperature to reach high cell densities.

buildSteps.title: Harvest and formulate
buildSteps.detail: Concentrate the cells and mix them with carriers or dry them so the product stays viable for months.

buildSteps.title: Apply in the vertical farm
buildSteps.detail: Add the formulated community to the hydroponic solution or growing substrate at the right growth stage.

buildSteps.title: Monitor and adjust
buildSteps.detail: Sample roots and substrate regularly to check that the microbes establish and that plants take up more nutrients.

prerequisites.why: we do not yet fully understand how communities assemble and communicate with roots.
needed to produce consistent, high-density cultures at commercial volumes.
allows strains to be enhanced or new functions to be added.
keeping microbes viable in storage and after application is a major challenge.
rules for engineered microbial communities are still developing in most countries.
vertical farms provide a contained system where the microbiome can be managed and monitored.

pathway.milestone: single-strain biofertilisers, such as Rhizobium for legumes, are commercially available
pathway.unlocks: proof that microbes can partly replace chemical fertiliser in specific crops.

pathway.milestone: defined multi-species consortia enter pilot trials in hydroponic and vertical farm systems
pathway.unlocks: data on how communities behave in soilless, controlled environments.

pathway.milestone: commercial products for vertical farms that cut fertiliser use by a measurable fraction
pathway.unlocks: lower operating costs and less nutrient runoff.

pathway.milestone: self-regulating synthetic soil microbiomes that cycle nutrients and suppress pathogens
pathway.unlocks: near-zero fertiliser vertical farming with stable yields.
